coreFeatures.title: What PDR Kalk can do

cards.heading: Hail & parking damage estimation
cards.desc: 5 price matrices (VFFS, Zurich mixed-hail, German AW Matrix with de-/remount column, Austria, Belgium UPEX List) with live calculation across 14 panels. Australia: hail estimate per panel, per vehicle, triage, or hours. Parking damage: per panel, flat rate, or time-based.

cards.heading: Documents & manual invoices
cards.desc: Cost estimate, report, invoice, Swiss QR invoice and ZUGFeRD/Factur-X e-invoice (PDF/A-3 with embedded XML) for Germany — all as PDF with your logo. Plus credit notes, assignment declaration, freeform manual invoices and a one-click job-package ZIP. It also produces replacement-vehicle rental contracts and vehicle-handover protocols — each with signature, PDF print and email.

cards.heading: Insurance direct workflow
cards.desc: Guided 4-step process: damage entry, assignment declaration with digital signature, send to insurer, automatic split invoice — including in-person customer approval.

cards.heading: Subcontractor workflow
cards.desc: Encrypted job transfer (AES-256), three compensation models with live split, dual-notify close-out, and duplicate-merge on re-import — complete audit trail between contractor and sub.

cards.heading: Analytics dashboard
cards.desc: Business intelligence at a glance: revenue & cashflow, receivables by due-date bucket, top customers, top insurers, payment duration and a conversion funnel — multi-currency.

cards.heading: Multi-device & local data
cards.desc: Sync the office PC, the workshop tablet and the accountant's PC through your own NAS or cloud — same data on every device. Shared-folder sync runs on Windows; Android tablets work standalone with the full feature set. Stays 100% local, GDPR compliant, 5 languages.

coreFeatures.disclaimer: PDR Kalk includes a generic German AW-based calculation option. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by any association or third party.

optionalAi.title: Type less. AI reads the vehicle registration.
optionalAi.subtitle: Photograph the registration document (CH Fahrzeugausweis / DE-AT Zulassungsbescheinigung) — the AI reads make, model, year, plate, VIN/chassis number and first registration and fills the fields in the report editor for you. Optional, off by default, using your own provider key.
optionalAi.vinNote: The VIN scanner reads the chassis number straight off the vehicle — the crop is freely adjustable for better recognition — or you type it in by hand. It reads either on the device (offline) or via your AI provider (online); make and approximate model year are then decoded from the VIN offline.
optionalAi.providersLabel: You choose the AI provider — with your own key
optionalAi.providersNote: US providers only if you explicitly choose them — never set as the default.

pillars.heading: Personal data is redacted
pillars.desc: Before upload, the app blacks out the holder's name and address directly in the image. On-camera framing guide plus a mandatory review step — manual entry always available.

pillars.heading: Your key, straight to the provider
pillars.desc: Bring-your-own-key: you use your own provider key and pay them directly. The image goes from your device straight to the provider — never through PDR Kalk's servers.

pillars.heading: Compliant & auditable
pillars.desc: The scan starts only once you've confirmed a few things — for example that your data won't be used to train the AI, and how long it's kept. Only the fact that a scan happened is logged — never the image, your key, or the data read. Built around Swiss and EU data-protection law.

optionalAi.framing: Once you enable and use the feature, the redacted image is sent only to the provider you choose — with your key, never through PDR Kalk. Without activation, nothing leaves your device.

items.quote: PDR Kalk ist für mich als PDR-Techniker eine enorme Arbeitserleichterung. Die Software ist übersichtlich, professionell aufgebaut und spart täglich viel Zeit bei der Kalkulation von Hagel- und Parkschäden. Besonders schätze ich die einfache Bedienung, die saubere Erstellung von Rapporten und Rechnungen sowie die zuverlässigen Berechnungen. Man merkt sofort, dass die Software von jemandem entwickelt wurde, der die PDR-Branche aus der Praxis kennt. Der Support ist schnell und kompetent. Klare Empfehlung für alle, die professionell und effizient arbeiten möchten.
items.name: Florian Huber

items.quote: PDRkalk ist aus meiner Sicht die beste Hagel- und Parkschaden-Berechnungssoftware auf dem Markt. Die Anwendung überzeugt durch eine extrem einfache und intuitive Bedienung und ist sowohl für Microsoft (Windows) als auch für Android verfügbar – ideal für den flexiblen Einsatz im Büro und unterwegs. Kalkulationen lassen sich schnell und übersichtlich erstellen, direkt digital versenden und nahtlos in Rechnungen umwandeln. Besonders stark ist die Möglichkeit, Arbeiten sauber zu unterteilen und mehrere Drücker als Subunternehmer gemeinsam in einem System arbeiten zu lassen. Dadurch bleibt jederzeit volle Transparenz über Leistungen, Abrechnungen und Zuständigkeiten erhalten. PDRkalk spart enorm viel Zeit, reduziert Fehler und sorgt für einen professionellen, strukturierten Ablauf – von der Schadenaufnahme bis zur Abrechnung. Für Betriebe im Bereich Hagel- und Parkschadeninstandsetzung ist diese Software ein echter Mehrwert und aus dem Arbeitsalltag kaum wegzudenken. Klare Empfehlung.
items.name: Jürg Strähl

items.quote: Die professionelle Kalkulations-App unterstützt Unternehmen bei der schnellen, präzisen und unkomplizierten Berechnung von Park- und Hagelschäden an Fahrzeugen. Die Anwendung überzeugt durch ihre besonders einfache Bedienung und ermöglicht eine effiziente Schadenerfassung. Hinterlegte Listen verschiedener Versicherungen erleichtern die Bearbeitung zusätzlich und sorgen für eine strukturierte, praxisnahe Abwicklung. Dank der Auswahl bereits hinterlegter Positionen lassen sich Kalkulationen zügig erstellen und individuell anpassen. Ergänzend bietet die App die Möglichkeit, individuelle Notizen und Ergänzungen einzufügen, um spezielle Anforderungen oder zusätzliche Informationen flexibel zu dokumentieren. Das Ergebnis ist ein ausgereiftes, professionelles Produkt, das Unternehmen bei der digitalen Schadenskalkulation zuverlässig und effektiv unterstützt.
items.name: Sandro Sciuto

items.quote: Sehr gute App mit einfacher und übersichtlicher Bedienung. Die Funktionen sind durchdacht und erleichtern die tägliche Arbeit deutlich. Besonders praktisch finde ich die Möglichkeit, mit Subarbeitern bzw. Teammitgliedern zu arbeiten. Insgesamt eine zuverlässige und professionelle Lösung. Klare Empfehlung!

privacy.metaDescription: Privacy notice for PDR Kalk's one-time online trial activation: which data is sent, why, and how long it is kept. GDPR and revDSG compliant.
privacy.title: Privacy notice — online trial activation
privacy.intro: When you first launch PDR Kalk and choose “Start 30-day trial”, we send a small amount of data once to our server to activate the trial. This prevents the same trial from being started repeatedly on a single device. The trial itself then runs fully offline — no further data is transmitted.
privacy.dataCollectedIntro: On first-time activation, PDR Kalk sends to api.pdrkalk.ch:
dataCollectedItems: A device identifier as a hash value (HMAC-SHA256, one-way — cannot be reversed to plaintext)
Platform (Windows or Android) and app version
A truncated IP address (IPv4 /24, IPv6 /48 — e.g. 203.0.113.0/24 instead of 203.0.113.42)
Operating system major version (e.g. “Windows 11” or “Android 14” — no detailed user-agent data)
After the subsequent region selection: the chosen region (CH, DE or AT)
dataNotCollectedItems: No name, email address or postal address
No company, customer, report or invoice data
No telemetry or usage data during the trial
privacy.purposeBody: The transmitted data is used solely to enforce one trial per device (abuse prevention). The legal basis is our legitimate interest in protecting against licence abuse under Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR or Art. 31(2)(d) revFADP (Switzerland).
privacy.retentionBody: The activation record is stored during the active trial (30 days) and for 30 days after expiry. After that, the truncated IP address is removed from the record. The device-identifier hash is kept permanently for abuse-prevention purposes — it contains no directly personal data.
privacy.processorBody: Server infrastructure: Cloudflare, Inc., 101 Townsend Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA. Cloudflare is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF). The database is configured in Cloudflare’s WEUR cluster (Frankfurt / Amsterdam); activation data is therefore normally processed exclusively within the EU.
privacy.rightsBody: You have the right to access, rectification, deletion, restriction of processing and objection. To exercise these rights, contact us by email at:
privacy.rightsContactNote: Please include your activation token (visible in the app’s licence dialog) so we can locate your record unambiguously.
privacy.fingerprintBody: On Windows 11 with MAC-address randomisation enabled, the device identifier may change over time. In rare cases this means the same device is recognised as a new one after a reinstall. If you need a legitimate second trial (e.g. after a hardware swap or restore), contact us at info@pdrkalk.ch and we will unlock it manually.
privacy.appHelpBody: A short summary of this information is also available directly in PDR Kalk under “Help → Trial privacy”.
privacy.aiBody: PDR Kalk includes an optional, off-by-default vehicle-document scanner. When enabled, an external AI vision API reads the vehicle data from a photo of the registration and fills the fields in the report editor. You use your own API key (bring-your-own-key); PDR Kalk runs no AI of its own and never sees the image or the key. The image is sent from your device straight to the provider you choose — never through PDR Kalk's servers. The following applies:
aiItems: Off by default — no image is transmitted unless you enable and use the feature.
Bring-your-own-key: you supply your provider's key; billing is directly with the provider.

Provider choice: Infomaniak (Switzerland, Swiss data centres), Mistral AI (EU/France), or — only after you explicitly acknowledge the cross-border transfer — OpenAI or Anthropic (US). It never silently switches to a US provider.

Automatic redaction: before upload, the app blacks out the holder's personal-data block (name and address) directly in the image (region-aware placement). An on-camera framing guide and a mandatory review step let you check the real photo before scanning.
Compliance checklist: the scanner runs only after you confirm a data-processing agreement (DPA), opt-out of model training, retention terms, and — for US providers — the cross-border transfer.
Metadata-only audit log: records provider, region, country, which fields were returned, success, and whether redaction was applied — never the image, key, or field values.
Designed around Swiss revFADP/nFADP and the EU GDPR.
